title: Finance Manager
locations: San Jose, California, United States of America
teaser: We are currently hiring a Finance Manager to drive results and support product finance initiatives. You will build and maintain financial models, analyse business performance, and collaborate with senior leaders. Ideal candidates have significant FP&A experience and strong financial modelling skills.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/24/2026
Members of the Finance organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet the Team 

This position is in the Product Finance team and will be working with Senior Product Leaders, other FP&A, Deal Desk, Operations, R&D, Pricing business partners and Accounting teams amongst others.

Your Impact 

You should be a driver of results, proactive in approach and deadline conscious.  Agility and passion while keeping a positive spin on relationships, willing to learn and develop skills are key to success. Strong financial modeling and analytical skills with attention to details, accuracy and building credibility will be needed in this role. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay flexible through growth and change is going to go a long way. Prior experience with P&Ls and supporting large engineering teams is a must.

Build and maintain Financials models as needed to support Product P&Ls (May include Bookings, Revenue, CSP spend, margin analysis, new product initiatives, partnership/deal assessments, Opex, Headcount) for business entities and management metrics.

Inform what the data is relaying while understanding the gaps and addressing those with long and short term recommendations.

Diving in the business to fully understand growth drivers and accelerators.

Work on New Product Initiatives P&L, launches, post launch assessment as needed.

Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting for forecast submissions, variance analysis and reporting dashboards.

Analyze results, distill/synthesize business performance indicators/metrics, assess business risk and operating performance, and timely communicate risks and opportunities.

Understanding of spend types and presenting those are a pivotal part of this role.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Accounting/Finance

6+ years of experience in FP&A incl few years with managing P&Ls, R&D budgets, revenue/cost modeling skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong Financial modeling experience

Able to dive in details as well as go high level to support senior execs

Strong systems skills (Hyperion, Anaplan etc)  

Preferred Qualifications

Pricing strategy experience

Masters Degree in Business

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
